Name: BingMiao's Dwarf Dialogue Expansion - English Translation
Author: DeadicatedGhost
Description:
I loved BingMao's dwarf portraits so much I just had to translate their "cute" dialogue for myself. I figured why not share the adorable new dialogue for others to enjoy too!

ALL CREDIT GOES TO BINGMAO
I only translated it to ENG. I made some minor changes in the dialogue to make more sense as Chinese to English translation is quite wonky without edits. I read over and cleaned up the whole thing, but there may be a few spelling/grammatical errors because I am not perfect.

The cute cave dwarf has in the screenshots comes from Jasper's NPC. It works great with the dwarf's new dialogue!
﻿https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5599
